guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: tight Alice in Chains clean-grit with dark mids and light chorus
tone.profile: tight Alice in Chains clean-grit with dark mids and light chorus
tone.summary: A clean, slightly gritty signal chain utilizing a UK 50/UK 45 style preamp for vintage grit, paired with Chorus and Room reverb to achieve the required subtle texture and dark mids.

rig.name: Alice in Chains - No Excuses - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain clean tones.
Provide the required 'slight grit' and subtle harmonic saturation without sounding like heavy overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its mild, dark breakup character, simulating a slight tube push rather than aggressive dirt.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more versatile option if the grit needs to be brighter.

blocks.purpose: Bypass this module to maintain the clean character and avoid excessive distortion.
blocks.gap: The tone requires only mild breakup (handled by Green OD), so a dedicated DST unit is unnecessary.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British clean/crunch tone (Marshall-style edge) while emphasizing dark mids for the required 'dark mids' character.
blocks.gap: The UK 50 is chosen over UK 45 for its slightly rounder, less aggressive clean headroom, fitting the grunge aesthetic.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more biting edge tone was desired.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound that complements the UK 50 amp model and supports the required tight low end.
Fine-tune the tone by slightly boosting mids and cutting lows/highs to achieve 'dark mids' and maintain a tight, focused sound.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ adjustments necessary to nail the specific dark, mid-heavy grunge texture.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the 'subtle chorus' effect required for verse texture without sounding washy or distracting.
blocks.gap: The settings are dialed back significantly to ensure subtlety, matching the requirement to keep the chorus subtle.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space and depth (ambience) without the washiness of Plate or Spring reverb.
blocks.gap: The Room setting is preferred over others to provide natural, non-washy ambience while fulfilling the need for texture.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the tight, dark mid-heavy grunge tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance tightness and dark mids for the grunge aesthetic.
